products.name: The Happy Sleeper: The Science-Backed Guide to Helping Your Baby Get a Good Night's Sleep-Newborn to School Age

reviews.content:
Our baby hit a sleep wall at around 4-5 months, and it was brutal...this book saved our sanity! In just 4 days we had a baby who could put her self to sleep, slept at least 12 hours, and woke up a well-rested, happy baby! One of the best parts about this book is how it is formatted, for starters, the sections are age focused, so you only need to read the section that pertains to your child. Second, the language is approachable. Even when presenting scientific information, the authors do so in a manner that is relatable to the average parent. These two factors make it perfect for busy parents who needs a solution as soon as possible.
I highly recommend this book for ALL parents...so much so that it has become my go-to baby shower gift!

reviews.content: Every mom I know, including myself, has had sleep issues with their young children at one point. Thank god this book has come along. With clear guidance backed up by science, the advice makes sense and feels right. I hadn't realized that sleep was such an important factor in a child's development. It's such an amazing gift I can give to my children. I've got post-its throughout this entire book so I won't be lending it out but I'll be buying it for every baby shower I attend!!
